description: This file implements a set of process functions for a Web Resource Owner Object in a web server system. The functions handle various HTTP request types such as notify, search, multicast search (MSearch), multicast post, subscribe, and unsubscribe. Each function primarily responds with a 'Method Not Allowed' status (HTTP 405) and includes an Allow header specifying permitted methods.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooDoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles a web request message to notify, responding with 'Method Not Allowed' and an Allow header.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooDoSearch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Processes a web search request, returning 'Method Not Allowed' with appropriate headers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooDoMSearch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles multicast search messages, responding with 'Method Not Allowed'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooDoMPost(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Processes multicast POST requests, returning 'Method Not Allowed'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooDoSubscribe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, responding with 'Method Not Allowed'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooDoUnsubscribe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles unsubscription requests, responding with 'Method Not Allowed'.
